narracion.hero_subtitle: No need to wait for someone to record an audiobook. Our AI turns any of the 1,400+ books into an immersive listening experience. Real time. No waiting.
narracion.works_subtitle: Three steps between you and listening to any book in the world.
narracion.s1_desc: Browse the library or upload your own PDF. Open the integrated reader and find the page you want to listen to.
narracion.s2_desc: A single click activates the Oracle's Voice. The AI processes the text and starts reading with natural intonation, respecting punctuation and context.
narracion.s3_desc: Control the speed, pause whenever you want, and ask Hermes AI about what you just heard. It's like having a private tutor.
narracion.c1_desc: Our AI uses state-of-the-art voice synthesis models to create narrations that sound human, not robotic.
narracion.c2_desc: From 0.5x for deep meditation to 2x for fast studying. You control the reading pace.
narracion.c3_desc: Jump between sections, go back a paragraph, or skip to the next topic. Full control over the narration.
narracion.c4_desc: Pause the narration and the text is highlighted exactly where you left off. When you return, reading continues without losing context.
narracion.u1_desc: Transform your commute into a deep learning session. The road becomes your study room.
narracion.u2_desc: Close your eyes and let meditation texts, mantras, or philosophy guide you in your practice at a relaxed speed.
narracion.u3_desc: Listen to a book at 1.5x while taking notes. Cover more material in less time and then dive deeper with Hermes AI.
narracion.u4_desc: Set a timer and let the AI voice accompany you until you fall asleep with ancient wisdom.

hermes.hero_subtitle: Confusing symbol? Cryptic passage? Impossible concept? Hermes AI reads with you and answers any question with the exact context of the page you are reading.
hermes.conv_subtitle: It's not a search engine. It's an intelligent dialogue with the text itself.
hermes.chat1_q: What does the Ouroboros mean in the context of this chapter on alchemy?
hermes.chat1_a: In this chapter, the Ouroboros represents the eternal cycle of destruction and renewal that the alchemist seeks to master. The author connects it directly with the concept of solve et coagula (dissolve and coagulate), suggesting that personal transmutation first requires destroying old forms...
hermes.chat2_q: Summarize the key points of this chapter in 5 bullets.
hermes.chat2_a:
Here are the 5 key points of the chapter:
  • Meditation is not emptying the mind, but observing thoughts without attachment.
  • The author distinguishes between concentration (focusing) and contemplation (expanding).
  • The daily practice of 20 minutes produces measurable neurological changes in 8 weeks.
  • The personal mantra must resonate with the practitioner's natural vibration.
  • The stage of "inner silence" is only reached after mastering rhythmic breathing.
hermes.cap_title: What Hermes can do for you
hermes.c1_desc: Ask anything about the book you are reading. Hermes answers with the exact context of the current page.
hermes.c2_desc: Request an executive summary, a comparative analysis, or a list of key concepts. Hermes structures the information for you.
hermes.c3_desc: Hermetic alchemy? Hyperbolic geometry? Chakras and meridians? Hermes decodes any concept to your level.
hermes.c4_desc: "What is the relationship between this text and The Kybalion?" Hermes cross-references and finds connections between works in the library.
hermes.diff_title: Why is it different from ChatGPT?
hermes.d1_desc: ChatGPT doesn't have access to the book you are reading. Hermes does. It analyzes the exact text of the page you have open.
hermes.d2_desc: It doesn't invent or hallucinate. Its answers are anchored to the real content of the book, citing specific passages.
hermes.d3_desc: No need to copy and paste text into another tool. Hermes lives inside the reader, one click and you are chatting.
hermes.cta_title: Ready to have a personal tutor in every book?
hermes.cta_subtitle: Access unlimited Hermes AI with your membership.
